name: FIRERPA (lamda)
description: Controls Android devices from an on-device server with UI automation, remote desktop, MITM capture, and built-in Frida, exposed to agents through an MCP server and a Python client.

skills.name: UI Automation
skills.description: Drives apps with selectors, a UI watcher, virtual displays, OCR, and image matching.

skills.name: MCP Server
skills.description: Serves tools, resources, and prompts over streamable HTTP at /mcp/ for Claude, Cursor, and other clients.

skills.name: Remote Desktop
skills.description: Streams and controls the device from a browser with multi-user access.

skills.name: Packet Capture and MITM
skills.description: Installs a root CA and captures traffic globally or per app with one command or the API.

skills.name: Built-In Frida
skills.description: Bundles Frida with persistent scripts and exposes Frida RPC as Python and JSON-RPC calls.
